items.source: Resolves the placeholders in the given values, replacing them with the platform derived from the DatabaseDriver of the given dataSource.
items.translation: 解析给定 values 中的占位符，将其替换为源自给定 dataSource 的 DatabaseDriver 推导出的平台。

items.source: Creates a new PlatformPlaceholderDatabaseDriverResolver that will map the given driver to the given platform.
items.translation: 创建一个新的PlatformPlaceholderDatabaseDriverResolver，它将把给定的driver映射到给定的platform。

items.source: values - the values in which placeholders are resolved
the values with their placeholders resolved
Creates a new resolver that will use the default "@@platform@@" placeholder.
items.translation: 创建一个使用默认 "@@platform@@" 占位符的新解析器。

items.source: Creates a new resolver that will use the given placeholder.
items.translation: 创建一个新的解析器，该解析器将使用给定的placeholder。

items.source: Resolves the placeholders in the given values, replacing them with the given platform.
items.translation: 解析给定values中的占位符，并用给定的平台替换它们。

items.source: By default, the name of the platform is the ID of the driver. This mapping can be customized by withDriverPlatform(DatabaseDriver, String) registering custom DatabaseDriver to platform mappings.
dataSource - the DataSource from which the DatabaseDriver is derived
items.translation: dataSource - 由 DatabaseDriver 派生的 DataSource
